verdict.rationale: Lever documents in-product custom reporting: users can build, templatize and share dashboards with repeatable trend and rolling-average analysis. For getting data out, the only evidence is a documented general Data API (list applications, list audit events) with a field-stability commitment, which an analyst could pull into a warehouse; there is no dedicated reporting API. Missing for 10: scheduled exports, BI/warehouse connectors, a reporting-specific API or export of report and dashboard data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can build custom reports and get the data OUT — scheduled exports, BI connectors, or a documented reporting API to my warehouse
